faq.answer: No. Scarcity, caregiving, migration, entrepreneurship, disability access, or disaster preparation can demand resourcefulness. Compare behavior after essential access becomes stable.
faq.question: Does resourcefulness establish self-preservation Seven?

faq.answer: Record what each person gives, whether obligations are explicit, how long the relationship persists after a need is met, and whether refusal remains possible without losing essential support.
faq.question: How should reciprocal alliances be evaluated here?

faq.answer: If reliable housing, food, transport, and care sharply reduce practical option seeking and instrumental networking, the environmental explanation should gain weight over subtype.
faq.question: Which material change can disconfirm this subtype?

sections.body_md: The tradition proposes that possibility attention may focus on supplies, useful contacts, comfortable arrangements, and practical routes around constraint. Treat this as a question about repeated function, not a conclusion from material success.
sections.title: Frame resourceful option building as a tentative tradition

sections.body_md: Use two periods with similar duties but different access to money, food, housing, transport, and care. Ask whether alliance building and practical option expansion remain equally prominent once scarcity is reduced.
sections.title: Compare households after resources stabilize

sections.body_md: Self-preservation here names a traditional attention lens for resources and continuity, not evidence about bodily mechanisms. Medical needs, disability access, and material danger require their own facts and qualified support.
sections.title: Describe an attention convention rather than physiology

sections.body_md: A person may look sociable, generous, or commercially agile while still tracking access and fallback routes. Conversely, private budgeting or a small trusted network may carry the same proposed function.
sections.title: Allow warmth and pragmatism to coexist with limits

sections.body_md: Housing insecurity, food cost, chronic illness, dependent care, immigration rules, disaster preparation, and informal economies can make resources and alliances necessary. Do not psychologize adaptive provisioning.
sections.title: Put scarcity and care obligations ahead of subtype

sections.body_md: Confidence falls when stable access sharply reduces deal seeking, stockpiling, comfort planning, or instrumental networking, especially if the person then prefers one simple route and accepts material limits without replacement plans.
sections.title: Test whether security reduces resource scanning

sections.body_md: Evidence from an instrument and sample cannot establish a universal subtype structure. This page offers a revisable observation exercise and cannot rank financial skill, health, resilience, generosity, or future security.
sections.title: Keep ontology and cross-cultural claims closed

sections.body_md:
Duration: 6

Context: Compare one resource-tight day and one adequately supplied day within six days while holding the main household or work obligation as constant as possible.

Observable signal: Log access to food, money, transport, care, comfort, useful contacts, promises exchanged, and the number of practical alternatives pursued.

Page-specific signal: Test whether alliance and option building continue after essential access becomes reliably available.

Alternative explanation: Review scarcity, housing risk, disability access, caregiving, migration status, disaster preparation, and local mutual-aid norms.

Reflection prompt: Name the resource change that best explains the behavior, then reduce the subtype interpretation if that explanation fits better.

seo.description: Type Seven self-preservation is a traditional, evidence-limited hypothesis combining Type Seven possibility with practical options, resources, comfort access, and reciprocal alliances. Networking or provisioning does not establish subtype because scarcity, caregiving, housing security, disability access, migration, and ordinary mutual aid can produce the same behavior.
seo.title: Type Seven self-preservation: a practical options, resources, and reciprocal alliance hypothesis
